title: Concept: robots.txt names sensitive paths
description: A robots.txt disallow rule pointing at an administrative or private path in a response gives every reader the same view the bank has internally: The file is public by design, so each disallow entry hands an attacker the exact path of an administrative, backup or debug area that the crawler was asked to skip.
applicability: Sites that hide administration by asking crawlers not to index it.
risk: The list is a directory of the areas the owner considers sensitive, in the order they were added.
